description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for user registration, login, and profile retrieval using FastAPI. It includes route handlers with detailed exception handling, logging, and interaction with service and database layers.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI's routing class used to define API endpoints for auth functionalities.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for login request payload containing email and password.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for user registration payload containing email and password.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the JWT token response after login.

classes.name: UserResponse
classes.description: Schema for including user information returned by endpoints.

methods.name: register_user( payload: RegisterRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Handles user registration, delegates to AuthService, manages exceptions, and logs events.

methods.name: login( payload: LoginRequest, db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Auth endpoint for user login, returning a token upon successful authentication.

methods.name: get_me( user_id: Annotated[int, Depends(get_current_user_id)], db: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_db)], auth_service: Annotated[AuthService, Depends(get_auth_service)], )
methods.description: Retrieves current user profile information based on provided authentication token.
